ANSWER: NO
HALLUCINATIONS: None

The memo accurately reflects the key financial terms and information present in the source document. All specific terms mentioned in the memo are supported by the source document, including:

- Parties: Ultra Resources Inc. (Delaware corporation, debtor-in-possession), Wilmington Trust National Association (Administrative Agent), UP Energy Corporation (Parent Guarantor)
- Dates: August 11, 2020 (amendment date), May 19, 2020 (original agreement date)
- Covenant terms: All hedging restrictions, percentages (33% through September 2021, 25% thereafter), daily limits (10,000-20,000 MMBtu), notification requirements (3 business days), and termination dates (March 2022) are accurately stated
- Document structure: Second amendment to DIP credit agreement with superpriority status

The memo appropriately notes "N/A" for deal terms not disclosed in this amendment document (deal size, price, interest rate, etc.) rather than fabricating information. The absence of these terms in the memo is appropriate since this is an amendment document rather than the original credit agreement.

ANSWER: NO
MISSING_TERMS: None

The memo appropriately captures all the key financial terms available in this amendment document. Since this is an amendment to an existing credit agreement rather than the original agreement itself, the fundamental deal terms (loan amount, interest rate, maturity date, payment frequency) are not present in the source document and therefore cannot be included in the memo. 

The memo correctly identifies and includes all the material financial terms that are present in the amendment:
- Hedging percentage limits (33% through September 2021, 25% through March 2022)
- Daily swap volume limits (10,000-20,000 MMBtu depending on market conditions)
- NYMEX price volatility threshold (5%)
- Notification timeframe (3 business days)
- Swap agreement termination date (March 2022)
- Key parties and their roles
- Amendment effective date (August 11, 2020)
- Original credit agreement date (May 19, 2020)

The memo also appropriately notes in the Key Deal Terms Table that certain fundamental terms are "N/A" since they are not specified in this amendment document, which is the correct approach for this type of source material.
